title: Optimizing SaaS Onboarding with PostHog AI Integration
business: A B2B SaaS platform providing project management tools for remote creative teams.
problem: Product managers struggle to identify specific friction points in the user onboarding flow because manual data analysis of event logs is time-consuming and often misses subtle behavioral patterns.
solution: By integrating the PostHog ChatGPT plugin, the team gains direct conversational access to product analytics and feature flag states, allowing them to query user drop-off patterns and toggle onboarding experiments without writing custom SQL or switching between dashboards.
steps: Connect the PostHog plugin to the team's ChatGPT account using the organization's API key.
Ask the AI to identify the top three steps where new users drop off during the initial project setup.
Review the suggested feature flag status for the current onboarding experiment directly in the chat interface.
Toggle the feature flag to enable a simplified setup flow for a subset of users to test if it improves conversion.
outcome: The product team achieves faster iteration cycles by instantly correlating user behavior data with active experiments, leading to a more intuitive onboarding experience.
limitation: The plugin relies on the accuracy of natural language interpretation of complex event data; users must verify findings by checking the raw event logs in the PostHog dashboard to ensure the AI has not misinterpreted a specific event property.
